description: Like Expression, but on whole numbers (unsigned 32-bit) and with bit operations: and, or, xor, not, shifts, rotates, get, set, clear or toggle a bit, count the bits set. The result goes to the output.

activation.text: Runs when one of the inputs it reads is fresh, or on each pass an enable fires, and the block is enabled. Its enable-out is on for the pass the result was written.

group.description: Read by the formula by position, as whole numbers; only the inputs it names are read, and every input it names must be wired.
group.label: hidden

outputs.description: The value of the formula, an unsigned 32-bit number.
